space.yaml, the input of servtuner propose: what a tuning session may change and how. Beyond the schema, servtuner propose checks that every knob is a vLLM knob, that a knob lists values or bounds but not both, that only max\_num\_seqs, max\_num\_batched\_tokens and max\_model\_len take bounds, and that no knob is both in base and tuned. Defaults: objective slo\_rps\_per\_gpu, noise\_floor 0.05, confirm top 3 and repeats 3; ladder probe\_rps 1 to 128 doubling, screen\_factors \[0.7, 0.85, 1, 1.15, 1.3\], full\_factors \[0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 0.95, 1, 1.05, 1.15, 1.3, 1.5\].

Schema file: `schema/json/search-space.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `5b46cdad0e5c`.

## Top level

| Field             | Type                                                                       | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `objective`       | [objectiveName](/reference/schemas/comparison/#objectivename)              | No       | The objective ranked; default slo\_rps\_per\_gpu.                                                                                                             |
| `noise_floor`     | `number`                                                                   | No       | The run-to-run noise as a fraction: a challenger must beat the leader by more than this to take over. Default 0.05. &gt; 0; &lt; 1                            |
| `min_concurrency` | `number`                                                                   | No       | The concurrency the workload preset needs the KV cache to hold: a boot probe whose c\_kv is below it drops the configuration. Absent or 0 means no check. ≥ 0 |
| `base`            | [tuningKnobSet](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningknobset)            | No       | Knobs set on every configuration and never tuned.                                                                                                             |
| `knobs`           | array of [tuningKnobSpec](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningknobspec) | Yes      | The tuned knobs.                                                                                                                                              |
| `ladder`          | [tuningLadderSpec](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningladderspec)      | No       |                                                                                                                                                               |
| `confirm`         | [tuningConfirmSpec](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningconfirmspec)    | No       |                                                                                                                                                               |

## Definitions

### tuningTier

The stages of the search, in this order: feasibility (boot probes with no load), structural, scheduler (advisor-guided), fine\_tuning.

Type: `"feasibility"`, `"structural"`, `"scheduler"`, `"fine_tuning"`

### tuningKnobSet

Knobs by name, keyed like "vllm.max\_num\_seqs".

Type: map of [knobValue](/reference/runspec/#knobvalue)

### tuningKnobSpec

| Field     | Type                                                      | Required | Description                                                                                                                    |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name`    | `string`                                                  | Yes      | A vLLM knob name.                                                                                                              |
| `tier`    | [tuningTier](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningtier) | Yes      |                                                                                                                                |
| `values`  | array of [knobValue](/reference/runspec/#knobvalue)       | No       | The allowed values. Required except for the knobs the advisors move, which may give min and max instead. at least 1 item       |
| `min`     | `number`                                                  | No       |                                                                                                                                |
| `max`     | `number`                                                  | No       |                                                                                                                                |
| `default` | [knobValue](/reference/runspec/#knobvalue)                | No       | The value of the first run. Absent means vLLM's own default: the knob is left unset (a structural knob takes its first value). |

### tuningLadderSpec

| Field            | Type              | Required | Description                                                                                         |
| ---------------- | ----------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `probe_rps`      | array of `number` | No       | The first ladder of a session, in requests per second, before any SLO-max is known. at least 1 item |
| `screen_factors` | array of `number` | No       | Multiples of the leader's SLO-max: the screening ladder. at least 1 item                            |
| `full_factors`   | array of `number` | No       | Multiples of the leader's SLO-max: the confirmation ladder. at least 1 item                         |

### tuningConfirmSpec

| Field     | Type      | Required | Description                                                                  |
| --------- | --------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `top`     | `integer` | No       | How many configurations get the full ladder and repeats. Default 3. ≥ 2; ≤ 3 |
| `repeats` | `integer` | No       | Repeats of each confirmed configuration. Default 3. ≥ 2                      |
